ItemID: unavailable; Title: The Breeze: An Appreciation of JJ Cale; ALIGN: yes; RATING: 5; REASON: Old Sock makes this Clapton tribute a natural next listen; its relaxed blues sound suits my mood.
ItemID: unavailable; Title: Step Back; ALIGN: yes; RATING: 5; REASON: My interest in People, Hell & Angels makes Johnny Winter's blues guitar especially appealing; I'd choose this today.
ItemID: unavailable; Title: Let Me Get By; ALIGN: yes; RATING: NA; REASON: Soulful blues rock fits my listening, but I'll stick with my two strongest picks this visit.
ItemID: unavailable; Title: Croz; ALIGN: yes; RATING: NA; REASON: Its reflective songwriting appeals after You Should Be So Lucky, but I'm more interested in blues today.
ItemID: unavailable; Title: Heaven & Earth; ALIGN: no; RATING: NA; REASON: I'm not looking for progressive rock right now; I want something closer to my recent blues listening.
ItemID: unavailable; Title: The Endless River; ALIGN: no; RATING: NA; REASON: An atmospheric, largely instrumental album isn't what I feel like listening to today.
ItemID: unavailable; Title: Don Henley Cass County; ALIGN: yes; RATING: NA; REASON: Blown Away suggests some room for country in my listening, but this isn't an immediate pick.
ItemID: unavailable; Title: Rattle That Lock; ALIGN: no; RATING: NA; REASON: The guitar work could interest me, but its atmospheric rock direction doesn't match my current mood.
ItemID: unavailable; Title: Plain Spoken; ALIGN: yes; RATING: NA; REASON: Roots-oriented songwriting fits my interests, though I'm not curious enough to choose it this time.
ItemID: unavailable; Title: Led Zeppelin; ALIGN: yes; RATING: NA; REASON: Blues-based rock fits my Hendrix interest, but the broad title leaves me unsure which release this is.
